Problem Statement:
You are given with Principle amount($), Interest Rate(%) and Time (years) in that order. Find Simple Interest. Print the output up to two decimal places (Round-off if necessary). (S.I. = P_T_R/100)
Input Description:
Three values are given to you as the input. these values correspond to Principle amount, Interest Rate and Time in that particular order.
Output Description:
Find the Simple interest and print it up to two decimal places. Round off if required.
Explanation:
P = 1000 $
T = 2 Years
R = 5 %
S.I. = 1000_2_5/100 = 100.00
Sample Input:
1000 2 5
Sample Output:
100.00
